research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Atomo Coffee is researching modified coffee compositions and coffee substitutes by developing plant substrates treated by cross Maillard reaction, as described in methods for making post-Maillard cross-reaction substrate carrier materials to improve coffee characteristics. They are also working on cross-Maillardized plant substrates and methods for producing coffee and cacao substitutes using cross-Maillardized or non-cross-Maillardized carrier materials. These efforts focus on molecular coffee development.
